name: Aielo de Rugat (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow tower beneath a white eight-pointed star, between two white gorse plants.
history: The official flag of Aielo de Rugat is of proportions 2:3, blue, with a yellow tower masoned black and pierced azure, flanked by two gorse plants in white or pearl grey, the tower surmounted by an eight-pointed star in white or pearl grey; it was approved by resolution of 1 June 2015 of the Conseller of the Presidency and Agriculture, Fisheries, Food and Water and published in the DOCV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 6 February 2003.

features.role: two gorse plants flanking the tower
